symptom: The transcript reader checked pathname metadata, then reopened that pathname for an unbounded read; replacement could change the digested file, and growth could bypass the size limit.
rule: Principle 17 requires reading the held file after validating its metadata. Restore the statSync/readFileSync algorithm in scripts/zstack/transcript.mjs at e615da6f0cf8fdae4d47562945710de7a546ecf8 (fixed by bbf226c45af3ce349d9526b49739f0dd3f4ee124 in PR 790), adapted only to the current readBounded entry point and configurable limit. The enforcer must observe real pathname replacement and in-place growth, then check the consumed bytes and bounded refusal.
